purpose: Market-track Sasang: 4-quadrant softmax + entropy-based uncertainty + veto flags for coordinator / independent_lens_fusion_stub; deterministic; no LLM; not clinical.
human_commander_gate_v1: Every artifact includes human_commander_gate_v1: Track B banner, final_authority=human_commander, machine_output_role=decision_support_observation_only.

coordinator_fields.uncertainty.composite_uncertainty: Blend of 4-way entropy norm and (1 - upstream sasang confidence); higher=worse.
coordinator_fields.veto.force_hold: If true, fusion layer should treat lens as HOLD / down-weight per fusion_bridge.use_in_fusion_inputs.
coordinator_fields.fusion_bridge.direction_hint: Maps independent-lens direction_score to bull|bear|neutral for stub alignment.
